postal_system.assignment_rule: A current complete release must reconcile assignments from all three RAP-authorized public postal operators. A locator or public webpage is observational evidence, not a complete edition contract.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: Only an exact authorized Polygon/MultiPolygon or a clearly derived surface from complete permitted member addresses/roads may represent a full code.
postal_system.non_area_rule: Office points, postal-region prefixes, routes, P.O. boxes and organizations remain non-area unless an independent authorized postal perimeter exists.
postal_system.address_rule: Postcode containment provides postal context only. House numbers and buildings require separate permitted stable address/building relations.
postal_system.country_identity_rule: BA remains Bosnia and Herzegovina; operator region labels do not split, merge or rewrite country identity.

quality_gates.pass: Every declared code binds to a versioned complete release from the relevant authorized operator.
Every drawable code binds to valid rights-cleared postal Polygon/MultiPolygon or complete permitted members with reproducible derivation.
An approved immutable artifact is published with bytes and SHA-256.
The actual BA loader, API and app verify normalized search, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance and all failure/clear/re-search states.
No addressee, customer, delivery instruction, owner or land-rights data is published.

stages.definition: Operator assignments, point inventories, government geometry, rights and application gaps are inventoried.
Exact source contracts, byte-bound review and authority separation are reproducible.

Current rights-cleared complete-for-declared-coverage five-digit assignments across all three authorized public postal operators, with stable row identity, operator, edition, validity, schema and SHA-256, must reproducibly produce an approved immutable artifact and pass the actual BA AGID loader, API and app. A drawable postal area must be an exact official Polygon/MultiPolygon or a clearly derived surface from complete permitted address/road members; it retains official/derived/virtual class, source, basis date, confidence, omissions and uncertainty and passes normalized search, loading/no-result/multiple/invalid/API-failure states, fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear and re-search. Office points, postal-region prefixes, localities, administrative or cadastral units, parcels, buildings, routes, P.O. boxes, buffers, Voronoi cells, learned regions and AGID cells cannot become official full-code polygons. House numbers and buildings require separate permitted stable relations. Metadata, public pages, shared code and synthetic fixtures alone never establish M2.
Refresh, topology, ambiguity, coverage, privacy and rollback gates pass.
Two independent source refreshes and monitored rollback pass.
